从视频到打字机网页

参考一段抖音视频，做一个可输入文字的打字机网页：滑块、灯头与暖光跟随输入位置变化，收起键盘后可以阅读。

原视频 ↗ · 效果网页 ↗ · 视频拆解 ↗

技术亮点Blender × Web：把三维质感带进可交互网页

Blender 负责三维外观与图片；HTML / CSS / JavaScript + Canvas 负责真实输入、机械动作和灯光联动。

  1. 01看视频取帧，记录外观与动作
  2. 02–04制作外观Blender 建模、材质与出图
  3. 05–07实现网页拼装图片，连接输入与灯光
  4. 08对照修改测试功能，比较画面并返工
原片与实现效果对照

01从视频中截取打字和阅读两种画面

先看原视频里的两种画面：键盘展开、正在打字，以及键盘收起、阅读文字。键盘改变了可用高度，保留两张截图，才能检查网页在这两种情况下的布局。

当时 Codex 取出 1.50 秒和21.40 秒的画面，保存为 PNG，再拼成下面的对照图。这些图片直接来自原片，没有额外调用生图模型。

在项目根目录新建 reference/ 保存截图，并在 composition.md 记录纸面、台灯、导轨和滑块的位置。继续看视频，注明滑块横移、文字送纸、灯头转向，以及灯臂保持固定；这些记录决定后面哪些东西要单独控制。

跟做：截图文件与取帧命令

将视频放在项目根目录并命名为 source.mp4。安装视频处理工具 FFmpeg 后，在该目录执行以下命令；-ss 指定时间，-frames:v 1 只取一帧。再让 AI 将两张图左右拼接。

reference/
  reference-writing.png   打字截图
  reference-ui.png        阅读截图
  reference-board.png     并排图
  composition.md          位置与动作记录
ffmpeg -ss 1.50 -i source.mp4 -frames:v 1 reference/reference-writing.png
ffmpeg -ss 21.40 -i source.mp4 -frames:v 1 reference/reference-ui.png
1. 从原视频取出1.50秒的打字画面、21.40秒的阅读画面，分别保存为截图。
2. 将两张截图并排拼接，放入 reference/。
3. 记录纸面、台灯、导轨、滑块的位置，以及键盘展开前后的变化；注明哪些物体会动、哪些保持固定。

完成后检查

两种截图与位置/动作记录齐全。后续的制作和对照都使用这份依据。

接下来，制作截图里的台灯、导轨和滑块。

02让 AI 调用 Blender，先创建一个简单物体

Blender 是免费的三维制作软件。用它做出有厚度和反光的台灯、导轨与滑块，再生成网页图片。Codex 编写 Python 脚本，Blender 通过自带的 bpy 接口执行脚本、创建物体。

当时项目使用 Blender 4.5.14 LTS，并通过本地工具桥接启动它。重新跟做时，可以先直接调用 Blender 后台命令，验证脚本确实能执行。

先让 AI 写 blender/smoke.py：创建一个立方体，保存为 smoke.blend。.blend 是可编辑工程文件。下面从项目根目录运行；这是跟做时的最小环境测试。

blender --version
blender --background --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python blender/smoke.py
命令说明与当时的工具桥接

macOS 找不到 blender 时，可用安装路径 "/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender" 替换它。--background 表示后台执行，--python 指定脚本，--python-exit-code 1 让脚本错误返回失败。

原项目的 MCP 桥接是 AI 与本地程序之间的工具通道，负责查询版本、构建场景和生成图片；真正的建模仍由 Blender 执行 Python 完成。

1. 检查本机 Blender 版本和命令路径，确认能执行 Python 脚本。
2. 编写 blender/smoke.py，创建一个立方体并保存为 smoke.blend。
3. 用 Blender 后台命令运行脚本，打开保存的工程，确认物体确实生成。

完成后检查

实际命令成功，打开 smoke.blend 能看到立方体。确认环境可用后再制作完整模型。

将最小测试扩展为真正的台灯和机械物体。

03在 Blender 中做出台灯、导轨和滑块

读取第一步的截图，让 Codex 编写 blender/build-scene.py。当时没有下载现成模型，而是用圆柱组成导轨、倒角盒体组成滑块、旋转截面生成灯罩，再补上螺丝、轴承和内壁。倒角让边缘圆滑，反光更自然。

脚本把物体分组，方便编辑和分别生成图片：

Paper     纸面          Rail      导轨与齿条
Carriage  绿色滑块      Arm       固定灯臂
LampHead  灯头与灯泡    Studio    相机与灯光

灯罩和灯泡要一起转，灯臂保持不动。因此给灯头创建独立控制对象 LampHeadPivot，作为转轴；灯头零件放在它下面，灯臂独立。使用固定正交相机，避免部件因远近不同产生难以对齐的比例变化。

LampHeadPivot → 灯罩、灯座、灯泡
Arm           → 独立固定，不跟随灯头转动

执行脚本，保存 blender/generated/typewriter-scene.blend 和对象清单 scene-inventory.json。原模型有213个对象，跟做时重点检查形状、连接和转轴。

1. 根据参考截图编写 blender/build-scene.py，用圆柱、盒体和旋转截面制作导轨、滑块与灯罩。
2. 将纸面、导轨、滑块、灯臂、灯头和相机灯光分别分组，补上倒角与连接细节。
3. 给灯头设置独立转轴 LampHeadPivot，让灯罩、灯座和灯泡一起转，灯臂保持固定。
4. 放好固定正交相机，运行脚本并保存可编辑的 .blend 工程。

完成后检查

打开工程可分别编辑物体；旋转 LampHeadPivot 时只带动灯头，灯臂不动，零件不穿插。

形状完成后，再设置表面外观并生成图片。

04给物体设置外观，导出透明背景图片

先设置材质，也就是表面外观：外壳用绿色烤漆，导轨用金属，灯泡和灯罩内壁发出暖光。再让 Blender 从相机视角计算光照、阴影并生成图片，这叫渲染。

网页要单独移动滑块，所以用 blender/render-assets.py 分别导出导轨、滑块和灯臂。图片背景设为透明，叠到网页后就不会盖住纸面。

灯头另导出七个角度：−18°到18°，每隔6°一张，每个角度区分开灯和关灯。这样共得到 3 + 7 × 2 = 17 张图片。

灯臂与灯头共用相机、900×900画布和转轴。另输出 asset-manifest.json 图片清单，记录文件名、尺寸、角度、转轴及灯口坐标，供网页对齐和绘制光束。

跟做：渲染命令、设置与实际踩坑

从项目根目录执行；结果放入 blender/generated/assets/，同时保存最终可编辑工程。

blender --background --factory-startup --python-exit-code 1 --python blender/build-scene.py -- --render

本例采用Cycles、40次采样、去噪、AgX Medium High Contrast和曝光+0.20。Mac可尝试Metal GPU，否则使用CPU。灯泡曾因未更新父子变换而变成大白球，修复时先更新依赖计算再保留世界变换；材质插口名称也需匹配当前Blender版本。

1. 给外壳、金属与灯泡设置绿漆、金属和暖光材质。
2. 使用透明背景，分别渲染导轨、滑块和固定灯臂。
3. 将灯头按−18°到18°、每隔6°渲染开灯和关灯两态，共得到17张部件图片。
4. 保持灯臂和灯头的相机、画布与转轴一致，另存图片清单，记录尺寸、角度、转轴和灯口坐标。

完成后检查

17张透明PNG和图片清单齐全，轮廓与转轴对齐。文字和动态纸面光束不画进机械图片。

把这些图片与真实文字输入框组合成网页。

05用 HTML、CSS 和图片搭出写作页面

将PNG转成保留透明背景的WebP，放进 public/assets/；清单复制为 manifest.json，资源名对应WebP。本例图片质量为92，另生成可重复铺满的纸张纹理。

网页采用原生 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript。HTML 放文字输入框与图片，CSS 控制位置和遮挡，JavaScript 接动作。文件分工如下：

public/
  index.html   纸面、输入框、键盘与图片
  style.css    位置、层级与手机布局
  app.js       输入、滑块、保存与导出
  lamp.js      灯头转动与纸面照明
  assets/      WebP、纸张纹理与图片清单

导轨、滑块和灯臂各放一张图片；文字保留真实 textarea 输入框。灯头与光束分别使用 Canvas——网页中由JavaScript绘画的区域，方便持续改变朝向和照明。

页面结构示意
<div class="paper">
  <textarea></textarea>
  <img class="rail">
  <img class="carriage">
  <img class="lamp-arm">
  <canvas id="lamp-head"></canvas>
  <canvas id="paper-light"></canvas>
</div>

先按截图摆好静态页面，再接动作。用静态HTTP服务打开 public/；原归档工程也可安装依赖后用 npm run dev 启动。

1. 将透明 PNG 转为 WebP，连同图片清单放入 public/assets/。
2. 用 HTML 和 CSS 摆好纸面、真实 textarea、键盘，以及独立的导轨、滑块和灯臂图片。
3. 为灯头和纸面照明分别创建 Canvas，将输入逻辑放入 app.js、灯光逻辑放入 lamp.js。
4. 先完成静态布局，对照参考截图检查手机和桌面上的位置，再连接动作。

完成后检查

资源全部加载，文字可编辑，各机械图片独立；手机和桌面布局均对齐。

下一步用文字光标的位置驱动机械动作。

06让输入的文字带动滑块和纸面

滑块要跟着文字光标横移，文字要随行数向上送纸。输入框只告诉我们光标在第几个字符，因此创建一份字体、宽度、行高都相同的隐藏文字镜像，在光标处插入标记，测量它的横纵坐标。

在 app.js 中，用这一份位置同步移动滑块、调整文字，并传给灯光模块：

文字或光标变化 → 测量光标位置
  横坐标 → 移动滑块
  纵坐标 → 文字送纸
  同一位置 → 灯光模块

模拟键盘也修改同一个输入框。中文组合输入完成后再落字，表情按完整组合删除；草稿存入浏览器 localStorage，导出也读取同一份文字。

实际返工：导轨下方的文字不显示

用户曾指出按上方向键后，导轨下方文字无法显示。后来将文字可见区域延伸到纸面下部，由导轨图片负责遮挡。历史后追加修复只留下源码和发布读回，跟做时需实际补验方向键。

1. 保留真实 textarea，用相同字体、宽度和行高的隐藏镜像测量光标位置。
2. 用同一份坐标移动滑块、调整文字送纸，并传给灯光模块。
3. 让模拟键盘与真实键盘修改同一输入框，处理中文组合输入和完整表情删除。
4. 加入草稿保存、刷新恢复和文本导出，检查换行及方向键移动时的联动。

完成后检查

输入、换行和移动光标时联动一致；中文不重复，表情能完整删除，刷新恢复正确。

把同一份光标位置交给台灯。

07让灯头转向输入位置，并画出暖光

光标靠左时让灯头朝左，靠右时朝右。使用第四步生成的角度图片，固定灯臂不参与旋转。

直接换图会跳动，混合两张图又曾产生重影。因此选最接近的一张，再绕转轴补转少量角度：例如目标8°，使用6°图片，再补转2°。

对图片清单里的灯口坐标做同样变换，再从新灯口位置绘制衰减、边缘柔和的暖光，避免灯头动了而光斑不动。逻辑写入 lamp.js：

follow(x,y) → 目标角度 → 最近图片 + 小角度补转
同样变换 → 新灯口位置 → 纸面暖光
setLit(value) → 同步切换灯头图片与照明

动画到达目标后停止申请画面更新；再次输入时才启动。

1. 将光标横坐标映射为灯头角度，选最接近的渲染图片，再绕转轴补转少量角度。
2. 对清单里的灯口坐标做相同变换，从新的灯口位置绘制衰减、边缘柔和的暖光。
3. 保持灯臂固定，开关灯时同步切换灯头图片与纸面照明。
4. 用 follow(x,y) 接收输入位置，动画到达目标后停止更新。

完成后检查

灯头转向、灯臂固定、边缘无重影，光束跟随灯口；关灯后纸面照明同步消失。

最后分别检查功能和视觉效果。

08对照原视频检查效果，再针对差异修改

先测输入、换行、方向键、键盘收起、中文、表情删除、刷新恢复和导出。真实手机的系统键盘与输入法要在设备上再验，窄屏只检查布局。

再用相同视口、文字和开关灯状态，对照第一步的原片截图，检查纸面、台灯、导轨、滑块与照明。下面是历史完成后的两种网页画面：

差异要回到对应位置修改：布局查CSS；形状与反光回Blender；换图跳动查相机和图片清单；机械与输入不同步查 app.js；灯头与光束不同步查 lamp.js。

修改后按原条件复测，把前后图、原因和结果保存在 review/。每轮依据具体差异继续优化。

1. 检查输入、换行、中文、表情删除、键盘收起、保存恢复和导出。
2. 固定视口、文字和开关灯状态，分别将打字与阅读画面同原视频比较。
3. 将差异定位到布局、模型材质、图片对齐或交互代码，修改对应部分后按原条件复测，保存前后图与结果。

完成后检查

可输入、保存和导出，机械与灯光联动正确；保留对照和测试结果，外观由使用者实际评价。

完整源码参考 · 按需查看

前文用短示意解释结构。需要查阅本例完整实现时，再展开下面的文件。

Blender 建模脚本
"""Original procedural typewriter scene. Run with Blender --background --python."""
import bpy, math, json, sys
from mathutils import Vector
from pathlib import Path

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT=HERE/'generated'
ASSETS=OUT/'assets'
ASSETS.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT');bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
for c in list(bpy.data.collections):
    if c.name!='Collection' and c.users==0:bpy.data.collections.remove(c)
scene=bpy.context.scene
groups={}
for name in ['Paper','Rail','Carriage','Arm','LampHead','Studio']:
    c=bpy.data.collections.new(name);scene.collection.children.link(c);groups[name]=c

def group(obj,name):
    for c in list(obj.users_collection):c.objects.unlink(obj)
    groups[name].objects.link(obj)
    return obj

def material(name,color,metal=0,rough=.35):
    m=bpy.data.materials.new(name);m.use_nodes=True
    p=m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(*color,1)
    p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=metal;p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=rough
    return m,p

paint,p=material('Sage enamel · powder coat',(.135,.19,.105),.58,.29)
p.inputs['Coat Weight'].default_value=.32;p.inputs['Coat Roughness'].default_value=.22
noise=paint.node_tree.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexNoise');noise.inputs['Scale'].default_value=185
bump=paint.node_tree.nodes.new('ShaderNodeBump');bump.inputs['Strength'].default_value=.07;bump.inputs['Distance'].default_value=.002
paint.node_tree.links.new(noise.outputs['Fac'],bump.inputs['Height']);paint.node_tree.links.new(bump.outputs['Normal'],p.inputs['Normal'])
steel,p=material('Brushed nickel',(.43,.46,.42),.93,.22)
p.inputs['Anisotropic'].default_value=.65
dark,p=material('Oiled gunmetal',(.055,.067,.052),.82,.3)
brass,p=material('Satin brass',(.46,.32,.125),.87,.27)
black,p=material('Rubber and seams',(.025,.029,.023),.05,.55)
ivory,p=material('Warm ivory enamel',(.83,.82,.65),.1,.35)
emission,p=material('Warm opal bulb',(.95,.88,.63),0,.27)
p.inputs['Emission Color'].default_value=(1,.88,.57,1);p.inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value=2.0
paper,p=material('Cotton paper · microfibre',(.76,.735,.655),0,.88)
n=paper.node_tree.nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexNoise');n.inputs['Scale'].default_value=320;n.inputs['Detail'].default_value=3
b=paper.node_tree.nodes.new('ShaderNodeBump');b.inputs['Strength'].default_value=.15;b.inputs['Distance'].default_value=.012
paper.node_tree.links.new(n.outputs['Fac'],b.inputs['Height']);paper.node_tree.links.new(b.outputs['Normal'],p.inputs['Normal'])

def finish(obj,name,mat,collection,bevel=0):
    obj.name=name;group(obj,collection)
    if mat:obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    if bevel:
        m=obj.modifiers.new('Machined rounded edge','BEVEL');m.width=bevel;m.segments=4
        m=obj.modifiers.new('Weighted highlights','WEIGHTED_NORMAL');m.keep_sharp=True
    for poly in getattr(obj.data,'polygons',[]):poly.use_smooth=True
    return obj

def box(name,loc,scale,mat,collection,bevel=.04):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1,location=loc);o=bpy.context.object;o.dimensions=scale
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False,rotation=False,scale=True)
    return finish(o,name,mat,collection,bevel)

def cyl(name,start,end,radius,mat,collection,vertices=64):
    a,b=Vector(start),Vector(end);v=b-a
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=vertices,radius=radius,depth=v.length,location=(a+b)/2)
    o=bpy.context.object;o.rotation_euler=v.to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler()
    return finish(o,name,mat,collection,min(radius*.18,.025))

def sphere(name,loc,scale,mat,collection):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=48,ring_count=24,location=loc);o=bpy.context.object;o.scale=scale
    return finish(o,name,mat,collection)

def torus(name,loc,major,minor,mat,collection,axis=(0,0,1)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=major,minor_radius=minor,major_segments=96,minor_segments=12,location=loc)
    o=bpy.context.object;o.rotation_euler=Vector(axis).to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler()
    return finish(o,name,mat,collection)

def screw(name,x,y,z,r=.04,collection='Carriage'):
    cyl(name,(x,y,z),(x,y,z+.035),r,brass,collection)
    ob=box(name+' slot',(x,y,z+.039),(r*1.35,.009,.005),black,collection,.002);ob.rotation_euler.z=.35

# Rail: two polished parallel rods, rack, long central bar and captive end mounts.
box('Rack backing',(0,-.075,.12),(8.8,.28,.16),dark,'Rail',.025)
for y,r in [( .19,.070),(-.23,.045)]:
    cyl('Polished guide rod',( -4.6,y,.22),(4.6,y,.22),r,steel,'Rail')
for i in range(155):
    x=-4.55+i*.059
    box('Rack tooth %03d'%i,(x,-.10,.241),(.026,.11,.065),steel,'Rail',.006)
for x in [-4.3,4.3]:
    box('End casting',(x,0,.17),(.25,.69,.38),paint,'Rail',.075)
    screw('Rail bolt',x,-.23,.355,.045,'Rail')
    screw('Rail pin',x,.24,.355,.031,'Rail')

# Carriage: real volume, stepped housings, bearing collars, metal cover and screws.
box('Lower dark housing',(0,-.025,.28),(1.25,.72,.28),dark,'Carriage',.10)
for x in [-.65,.65]:
    cyl('Linear bearing collar',(x-.07,.18,.22),(x+.07,.18,.22),.105,steel,'Carriage')
    cyl('Lower bearing collar',(x-.06,-.23,.22),(x+.06,-.23,.22),.085,dark,'Carriage')
box('Sage enamel body',(0,-.03,.47),(1.15,.72,.40),paint,'Carriage',.08)
box('Nickel top plate',(0,.13,.694),(1.095,.43,.058),steel,'Carriage',.045)
box('Front panel',(0,-.384,.462),(.995,.025,.28),paint,'Carriage',.037)
box('Body seam',(0,-.15,.684),(1.08,.014,.014),dark,'Carriage',.004)
for x in [-.455,.455]:screw('Top cover screw',x,.28,.733,.025)
screw('Brass adjustment screw',.386,-.23,.682,.069)
box('Typebar upright',(-.13,.61,.55),(.055,.43,.08),steel,'Carriage',.015)
box('Typebar elbow',(-.27,.827,.55),(.32,.057,.077),steel,'Carriage',.013)
box('Type slug',(-.43,.845,.57),(.09,.11,.10),brass,'Carriage',.012)
for x in [-.44,-.42]:box('Slug groove',(x,.847,.625),(.008,.083,.008),dark,'Carriage',.001)

# Lamp pivot at the threaded brass joint. The arm is a separate collection.
pivot=Vector((0,0,.7))
cyl('Fixed enamel lamp arm',(-2.15,-.57,.47),(-.03,.035,.71),.064,paint,'Arm')
cyl('Metal inner arm',(-2.15,-.57,.47),(-.03,.035,.71),.033,steel,'Arm')
cyl('Arm end ring',(-.14,-.004,.69),(-.015,.034,.71),.081,brass,'Arm')
sphere('Pivot joint',pivot,(.14,.14,.14),brass,'Arm')
bpy.ops.object.empty_add(type='PLAIN_AXES',location=pivot);headroot=bpy.context.object;headroot.name='LampHeadPivot';group(headroot,'LampHead')
axis=Vector((.17,-.97,-.11)).normalized();q=axis.to_track_quat('Z','Y');base=pivot+axis*.07

def lamp_point(z):return base+axis*z
cyl('Lamp socket',lamp_point(-.15),lamp_point(.20),.13,brass,'LampHead')
for i in range(9):torus('Socket thread %02d'%i,lamp_point(-.13+i*.036),.135,.009,brass,'LampHead',axis)
# Lathed double wall: outer coat, rolled rim and light ivory inside.
profile=[(.15,.142),(.22,.21),(.31,.28),(.44,.35),(.61,.43),(.83,.51),(1.06,.575),(1.11,.577)]
def lathe(name,profile,mat,reverse=False):
    verts=[];faces=[];segments=128
    for z,r in profile:
        for j in range(segments):
            angle=2*math.pi*j/segments
            verts.append(tuple(base+q@Vector((r*math.cos(angle),r*math.sin(angle),z))))
    for k in range(len(profile)-1):
        for j in range(segments):
            a=k*segments+j;b=k*segments+(j+1)%segments;c=b+segments;d=a+segments
            faces.append((d,c,b,a) if reverse else (a,b,c,d))
    mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new(name);mesh.from_pydata(verts,[],faces);mesh.update()
    ob=bpy.data.objects.new(name,mesh);groups['LampHead'].objects.link(ob);ob.data.materials.append(mat)
    for p in mesh.polygons:p.use_smooth=True
    return ob
lathe('Enamel bell shade',profile,paint)
lathe('Ivory shade interior',[(z+.008,r-.024) for z,r in profile],ivory,True)
torus('Rolled shade lip',lamp_point(1.105),.566,.018,paint,'LampHead',axis)
torus('Warm luminous inside lip',lamp_point(1.106),.544,.008,ivory,'LampHead',axis)
bulb=sphere('Opal bulb',lamp_point(.60),(.17,.17,.25),emission,'LampHead');bulb.rotation_euler=q.to_euler()
bpy.context.view_layer.update()
for ob in list(groups['LampHead'].objects):
    if ob!=headroot:
        matrix=ob.matrix_world.copy();ob.parent=headroot;ob.matrix_world=matrix

# Paper object is retained for scene editing; UI exports omit it.
box('Paper sheet',(0,0,-.08),(8.7,12,.08),paper,'Paper',.10)

world=bpy.data.worlds.new('Soft studio');scene.world=world;world.use_nodes=True
world.node_tree.nodes.get('Background').inputs[0].default_value=(.63,.67,.60,1)
world.node_tree.nodes.get('Background').inputs[1].default_value=.6
def area(name,loc,power,size,color,shape='DISK'):
    data=bpy.data.lights.new(name,'AREA');data.energy=power;data.shape=shape;data.size=size;data.color=color
    ob=bpy.data.objects.new(name,data);groups['Studio'].objects.link(ob);ob.location=loc;ob.rotation_euler=(-Vector(loc)).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler();return ob
area('Large softbox left',(-3,4,7),650,5,(1,.96,.87))
area('Long metal strip',(1,3,5),450,3,(.89,.94,1))
area('Right bounce',(4,-1,4),220,4,(1,.95,.81))
data=bpy.data.cameras.new('Fixed orthographic camera');cam=bpy.data.objects.new('Fixed orthographic camera',data);groups['Studio'].objects.link(cam);scene.camera=cam
CAM_OFFSET=Vector((0,-6,16))
def camera(target,ortho,w,h):
    cam.location=Vector(target)+CAM_OFFSET;cam.rotation_euler=(Vector(target)-cam.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler();cam.data.type='ORTHO';cam.data.ortho_scale=ortho
    scene.render.resolution_x=w;scene.render.resolution_y=h;scene.render.resolution_percentage=100

scene.render.engine='CYCLES';scene.cycles.samples=40;scene.cycles.use_denoising=True
scene.cycles.max_bounces=6;scene.cycles.transparent_max_bounces=6
scene.render.film_transparent=True
scene.render.image_settings.file_format='PNG';scene.render.image_settings.color_mode='RGBA';scene.render.image_settings.color_depth='8'
scene.view_settings.view_transform='AgX';scene.view_settings.look='AgX - Medium High Contrast';scene.view_settings.exposure=.20
try:
    prefs=bpy.context.preferences.addons['cycles'].preferences;prefs.compute_device_type='METAL';prefs.get_devices()
    for dev in prefs.devices:dev.use=dev.type=='METAL'
    scene.cycles.device='GPU'
except Exception:scene.cycles.device='CPU'

camera((0,0,0),9.2,1080,1560)
# Store a fully laid out editable scene using parent display empties.
scene['purpose']='Layered web typewriter: original geometry from reference study'
scene['lamp_pivot']=list(pivot);scene['source_reference']='N01 N04 N10 N11 N12'
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(OUT/'typewriter-scene.blend'))
(OUT/'scene-inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps({'blender':bpy.app.version_string,'collections':{k:len(v.objects) for k,v in groups.items()},'lamp_pivot':list(pivot),'camera_offset':list(CAM_OFFSET),'original_geometry':True},indent=2))
print('TYPEWRITER_SCENE_READY',flush=True)

if '--render' in sys.argv:
    exec(compile((HERE/'render-assets.py').read_text(),str(OUT/'render-assets.py'),'exec'))
Blender 渲染脚本
"""Called from build-scene.py; exports fixed-camera transparent layers."""
from bpy_extras.object_utils import world_to_camera_view

def visible(names):
    for name,collection in groups.items():collection.hide_render=name not in names and name!='Studio'

manifest={'generator':'Blender '+bpy.app.version_string,'cameraOffset':list(CAM_OFFSET),'renderEngine':'Cycles','samples':scene.cycles.samples,'assets':{},'angles':[]}
def render(name,collections,target,ortho,w,h):
    visible(collections);camera(target,ortho,w,h);bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    scene.render.filepath=str(ASSETS/(name+'.png'));bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
    manifest['assets'][name]={'file':name+'.png','width':w,'height':h,'orthoScale':ortho,'cameraTarget':list(target),'transparent':True,'collections':collections}
    print('RENDERED',name,flush=True)

render('rail',['Rail'],(0,0,.15),9.0,1800,190)
render('carriage',['Carriage'],(0,.25,.35),1.75,640,560)
target=(-.35,-.55,.55);scale=2.8;w=h=900
render('lamp-arm',['Arm'],target,scale,w,h)
bpy.context.view_layer.update()
point=world_to_camera_view(scene,cam,pivot)
manifest['lampPivot']={'x':point.x*w,'y':(1-point.y)*h,'canvas':w}
for deg in [-18,-12,-6,0,6,12,18]:
    headroot.rotation_euler.z=math.radians(deg)
    for mode,strength in [('on',2.0),('off',0.0)]:
        emission.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF').inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value=strength
        lining=ivory.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
        lining.inputs['Emission Color'].default_value=(1,.94,.76,1)
        lining.inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value=.8 if mode=='on' else 0
        name='lamp-head-'+mode+'-'+str(deg+18).zfill(2)
        render(name,['LampHead'],target,scale,w,h)
        bpy.context.view_layer.update()
        mouth=headroot.matrix_world@headroot.matrix_world.inverted()@lamp_point(1.11)
        # Rotate the rest-pose mouth position about the unchanged hinge.
        from mathutils import Matrix
        mouth=pivot+Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(deg),4,'Z').to_3x3()@(lamp_point(1.11)-pivot)
        xy=world_to_camera_view(scene,cam,mouth)
        manifest['angles'].append({'degrees':deg,'lit':mode=='on','file':name+'.png','mouth':{'x':xy.x*w,'y':(1-xy.y)*h}})
headroot.rotation_euler.z=0
emission.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF').inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value=2
ivory.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF').inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value=.8
visible(['Rail','Carriage','Arm','LampHead','Paper'])
# Place groups for an editable composed scene; exports above retain clean local coordinates.
for ob in groups['Rail'].objects:ob.location.y-=1.5
for ob in groups['Carriage'].objects:
    ob.location.x+=.6;ob.location.y-=1.5
for ob in groups['Arm'].objects:ob.location+=Vector((-2.8,4.0,0))
headroot.location+=Vector((-2.8,4.0,0))
camera((0,.7,0),9.2,1080,1560)
scene.render.film_transparent=False;scene.render.filepath=str(OUT/'scene-composition.png')
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(OUT/'typewriter-final.blend'))
bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
(OUT/'asset-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
print('TYPEWRITER_ASSETS_READY',flush=True)
index.html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#252820">
  <meta name="description" content="一盏灯，一张纸，给你的念头留一点空间。可以真正写字的机械打字机。">
  <title>纸间 · 一台会回应你的打字机</title>
  <script>if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('view')==='mobile')document.documentElement.classList.add('mobile-view');</script>
  <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 40 40'%3E%3Crect width='40' height='40' rx='10' fill='%23495442'/%3E%3Ctext x='9' y='29' font-size='29' fill='%23eee7d8' font-family='serif'%3Ep%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">
  <script src="lamp.js" defer></script>
  <script src="app.js" defer></script>
  <script src="mobile.js" defer></script>
</head>
<body>
  <svg class="icons" aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <symbol id="i-back" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m14 5-7 7 7 7"/></symbol>
    <symbol id="i-share" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 7H5v14h14V7h-3M12 15V2m-4 4 4-4 4 4"/></symbol>
    <symbol id="i-sun" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 1v2m0 18v2M1 12h2m18 0h2M4.2 4.2l1.4 1.4m12.8 12.8 1.4 1.4m0-15.6-1.4 1.4M5.6 18.4l-1.4 1.4"/></symbol>
    <symbol id="i-sound" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 9h4l5-4v14l-5-4H3zM16 8a6 6 0 0 1 0 8m3-11a10 10 0 0 1 0 14"/></symbol>
    <symbol id="i-shift" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m3 11 9-8 9 8h-6v9H9v-9z"/></symbol>
    <symbol id="i-delete" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 5h12v14H9l-7-7zM12 9l5 6m0-6-5 6"/></symbol>
    <symbol id="i-return" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 5v9H4m5-5-5 5 5 5"/></symbol>
    <symbol id="i-globe" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><ellipse cx="12" cy="12" rx="4" ry="9"/><path d="M3 12h18M5 6h14M5 18h14"/></symbol>
    <symbol id="i-play" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m9 5 11 7-11 7z"/></symbol>
    <symbol id="i-phone" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="6" y="2" width="12" height="20" rx="3"/><path d="M10 5h4m-3 14h2"/></symbol>
    <symbol id="i-close" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m6 6 12 12M18 6 6 18"/></symbol>
  </svg>

  <main class="workspace">
    <aside class="intro">
      <a class="wordmark" href="#" aria-label="纸间首页"><span class="brand-symbol">p.</span><span>纸间 <small>PAPER ROOM</small></span></a>
      <div class="intro-copy"><p class="eyebrow">A LITTLE ROOM FOR YOUR THOUGHTS</p><h1>给念头，<br>留一点空间。</h1><p class="intro-desc">打开灯，把世界调小一点。<br>剩下的，就交给你的指尖。</p><button id="demo" class="demo"><svg><use href="#i-play"/></svg> 看看打字效果 <span>↗</span></button></div>
      <p class="intro-foot">灵感来自 Jerry Nkongolo 与七的三次方<br><span>一张纸，可以装下很多事。</span><br><a href="archive.html">查看制作档案 ↗</a></p>
    </aside>

    <section class="app" aria-label="纸间打字机">
      <header class="toolbar">
        <button id="new-page" class="icon-button" aria-label="换一张新纸" title="换一张新纸"><svg><use href="#i-back"/></svg></button>
        <button id="done" class="done">完成</button><span class="toolbar-name">纸间</span>
        <output id="counter" class="counter" aria-label="已输入字数"><i></i><span>0</span> / 3000</output>
        <button id="export" class="icon-button" aria-label="导出文字" title="导出文字"><svg><use href="#i-share"/></svg></button>
      </header>

      <div class="paper" id="paper">
        <div class="paper-grain"></div><div class="paper-top"></div>
        <a id="mobile-link" class="mobile-link" href="/mobile" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-controls="mobile-dialog"><svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-phone"/></svg><span>手机体验</span><span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a>
        <canvas class="warm-light" id="light-beam" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
        <button id="lamp" class="lamp" aria-label="关闭台灯" aria-pressed="true" title="点一下，开关台灯"><img id="lamp-arm" src="assets/lamp-arm.webp" alt="固定的绿色金属灯臂" draggable="false"><img id="lamp-fallback" src="assets/lamp-head-on-18.webp" alt="" draggable="false"><canvas id="lamp-head" width="900" height="900" aria-label="独立转向的绿色灯头"></canvas></button>
        <div class="ink-window"><div class="ink" id="ink" aria-hidden="true"></div><textarea id="writer" aria-label="在纸上写字" inputmode="none" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="sentences" maxlength="6000"></textarea></div>
        <div class="placeholder" aria-hidden="true"><span>A little room</span><span>for your thoughts.</span></div>
        
        <div class="rail" aria-hidden="true">
          <img class="rail-render" src="assets/rail.webp" alt="" draggable="false">
          <div class="carriage" id="carriage"><div class="head" id="head"><img src="assets/carriage.webp" alt="" draggable="false"></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="paper-footer"><span id="paper-hint">轻点纸张，开始写字</span><button id="light" class="icon-button" aria-label="关闭台灯" aria-pressed="true"><svg><use href="#i-sun"/></svg></button></div>
        <div class="save-indicator" id="save-indicator" aria-live="polite"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="keyboard" id="keyboard" aria-label="屏幕键盘" inert>
        <div class="keys" id="keys"></div>
        <div class="keyboard-bottom"><button id="native" aria-label="切换到系统键盘以输入中文" title="中文 / 系统键盘"><svg><use href="#i-globe"/></svg><span>中文</span></button><span class="keyboard-note">让想法，慢慢落在纸上</span><button id="sound" class="sound" aria-label="关闭打字音效" aria-pressed="true"><svg><use href="#i-sound"/></svg></button></div>
      </div>
      <div class="home-indicator" aria-hidden="true"><i></i></div>
    </section>
    <p class="desktop-tip"><kbd>Enter</kbd> 换行 <span>·</span> 支持中文输入 <span>·</span> 草稿自动保存在此设备</p>
  </main>
  <div class="toast" id="toast" role="status"></div>
  <dialog id="new-dialog"><form method="dialog"><span class="dialog-mark">一页新的开始</span><h2>换一张新纸？</h2><p>当前文字会被清空。你也可以先导出，<br>把这一页好好留下。</p><div class="dialog-actions"><button value="cancel">继续写</button><button value="new" class="primary">换新纸</button></div></form></dialog>
  <dialog id="mobile-dialog" class="mobile-dialog" aria-labelledby="mobile-title" aria-describedby="mobile-description">
    <form method="dialog" class="mobile-close-form"><button class="mobile-close" aria-label="关闭手机体验窗口" autofocus><svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-close"/></svg></button></form>
    <span class="dialog-mark">把这一刻，带到手机上</span>
    <h2 id="mobile-title">在手机上，慢慢写。</h2>
    <p id="mobile-description">用手机相机扫码，直接打开打字机。</p>
    <img class="mobile-qr" src="assets/mobile-qr.svg" width="232" height="232" alt="手机体验二维码，链接也可在下方复制">
    <label class="mobile-url-label" for="mobile-url">手机直达链接</label>
    <div class="mobile-url-row"><input id="mobile-url" type="url" value="https://typewriter.paws.rodeo/mobile" readonly spellcheck="false"><button id="copy-mobile-link" type="button">复制链接</button></div>
    <p id="mobile-copy-status" class="mobile-copy-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <a class="mobile-open" href="/mobile" target="_blank" rel="noopener">直接打开手机页面 <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a>
    <p class="mobile-note">无需安装 · 草稿保存在写作的设备上</p>
  </dialog>
</body>
</html>

/* Blender materials edition: keep proven keyboard and dialog structure. */
:root{--paper:#e9e6db;--ink:#37382f;--shell:#24271f}
.workspace{grid-template-columns:270px 460px;column-gap:76px;width:946px;padding:30px 50px 48px}
.app{width:460px;height:min(880px,calc(100svh - 76px));border-radius:24px;background:#25281f}
.intro{height:min(760px,83vh)}.intro-copy h1{font-size:34px;line-height:1.8;letter-spacing:3px}.intro-desc{font-size:12px}.intro-foot a{color:#949e87;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid #66735d44}.desktop-tip{width:460px}
.paper{background:#e9e6db url('assets/paper-grain.webp') repeat;background-size:256px 256px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px #fff,inset 0 12px 16px -13px #7b6d4fa0,inset 0 -30px 70px -50px #61544070}
.paper::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#fff4,transparent 35%,#867c6410 100%)}
.paper-grain{display:none}.paper-top{height:21px;opacity:.8;background:linear-gradient(#fff9,transparent 15%,#fff2 45%,#8f826525 80%,transparent)}
.warm-light{width:100%;height:100%;background:none;inset:0;mix-blend-mode:normal;transition:opacity .32s;z-index:1}
.lamp{left:-51px;top:-29px;width:202px;height:202px;filter:drop-shadow(3px 9px 7px #34372340);transform:none;transition:filter .35s;isolation:isolate}
.lamp:hover,.lamp:active{transform:none}.lamp img,.lamp canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}.lamp img{z-index:1}.lamp canvas{z-index:2}.light-off .lamp{filter:drop-shadow(3px 9px 7px #34372340) brightness(.94)}
.ink-window{z-index:3;pointer-events:auto}.ink{visibility:hidden;transition:none;user-select:none;left:42px;right:68px;font:500 17px/31px "Courier New",Courier,"Songti SC",monospace;letter-spacing:.15px}
.paper textarea{opacity:1;inset:auto;top:0;left:42px;width:calc(100% - 110px);height:100px;min-height:1px;padding:0;margin:0;border:0;border-radius:0;overflow:hidden;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;tab-size:8;font:500 17px/31px "Courier New",Courier,"Songti SC",monospace;letter-spacing:.15px;color:var(--ink);caret-color:#575f43;z-index:4;user-select:text;touch-action:pan-y;resize:none;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-shadow:.2px .2px #4b4a3428;transition:none}
.paper textarea::selection{background:#a8b59070}.paper textarea:not(:focus){caret-color:transparent}.placeholder{left:42px;font-weight:500;font-size:17px;line-height:31px;color:#464837}
.rail{height:auto;aspect-ratio:1800/190;z-index:6;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 2px #30332248)}.rail-render{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}
.carriage{width:80px;height:70px;top:calc(50% - 44px);transition:left .09s cubic-bezier(.14,.75,.25,1);filter:drop-shadow(1px 7px 4px #292c214c)}.head{width:80px;height:70px}.head>img{display:block;width:80px;height:70px}
.paper-footer{color:#777d6b}.paper-footer #paper-hint{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.5px;opacity:.75}.editing .paper-footer #paper-hint{opacity:0}.toolbar-name{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px}.counter{letter-spacing:1.5px;font-size:10px}.keyboard{background:#2b2f27}.key{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#54584e,#4c5046);box-shadow:0 1px 0 #10150cb0}.key.special{background:#3f453a}.keyboard-note{letter-spacing:1px}.key.active,.key:active{background:#8b987a}
@media(min-width:1400px){.workspace{grid-template-columns:290px 480px;width:1030px;column-gap:100px}.app{width:480px}.desktop-tip{width:480px}.intro-copy h1{font-size:36px}}
@media(max-width:850px){.workspace{display:flex;width:100%;padding:25px 15px 45px}.app{height:calc(100svh - 70px)}.intro{display:none}.desktop-tip{width:auto}}
@media(max-width:520px){.workspace{display:block;padding:0;width:100%;height:100dvh}.app{width:100%;height:100dvh;min-height:0;border-radius:0}.lamp{width:190px;height:190px;left:-50px;top:-25px}.ink,.paper textarea{left:36px;right:64px;font-size:16px;line-height:30px;letter-spacing:.15px}.paper textarea{width:calc(100% - 100px);right:auto}.placeholder{left:36px;font-size:16px;line-height:30px}.toolbar{height:calc(56px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));min-height:calc(56px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px))}.paper-footer{bottom:11px}.home-indicator i{background:#dfe1d2;height:4px;width:112px}}
@media(max-height:670px) and (max-width:520px){.lamp{width:153px;height:153px;left:-39px;top:-26px}.paper textarea{inset:auto;top:0;left:29px;right:auto;width:calc(100% - 92px);height:100px}.ink{left:29px;right:63px}.placeholder{left:29px}.paper-footer{bottom:3px}}

#lamp-fallback{z-index:2}.assets-ready #lamp-fallback{display:none}

/* Phone handoff: a quiet link in the top-right corner of the paper. */
.mobile-link{position:absolute;top:22px;right:22px;z-index:9;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:40px;padding:0 11px;border:1px solid #63735630;border-radius:22px;background:#fffdf33b;color:#53624b;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.4px;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s}
.mobile-link svg{width:16px;height:16px;stroke-width:1.5}.mobile-link:hover{background:#fffdf3b3;border-color:#63735666}.mobile-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #53624b;outline-offset:3px}
.mobile-dialog{position:fixed;box-sizing:border-box;width:min(390px,calc(100vw - 32px));max-height:calc(100dvh - 32px);margin:auto;padding:36px 26px 24px;border:1px solid #e4e2d5;border-radius:22px;background:#f4f1e7;color:#303b2c;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 24px 90px #0007;overflow:auto;color-scheme:light}
.mobile-dialog::backdrop{background:#10190f99;backdrop-filter:blur(7px)}.mobile-close-form{margin:0}.mobile-close{position:absolute;right:12px;top:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;width:36px;height:36px;color:#66735c;border-radius:50%;padding:0}.mobile-close:hover{background:#dce1d3}.mobile-close svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.mobile-dialog .dialog-mark{display:block;color:#718064;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px}.mobile-dialog h2{margin:12px 0 8px;font-size:24px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:1px}.mobile-dialog p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:#707867;margin:0}.mobile-qr{display:block;width:232px;max-width:100%;height:auto;margin:20px auto;border:1px solid #dde1d3;border-radius:12px;background:#fff}
.mobile-url-label{display:block;text-align:left;font-size:10px;color:#748168;margin-bottom:7px}.mobile-url-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.mobile-url-row input{min-width:0;flex:1;width:100%;height:40px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid #cfd7c4;border-radius:8px;background:#fffdf8;color:#526047;font:11px ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,monospace;user-select:all}.mobile-url-row input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #748764;outline-offset:2px}.mobile-url-row button{height:40px;flex-shrink:0;padding:0 13px;background:#536449;border-radius:8px;color:#fffef7;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.3px}.mobile-url-row button:hover{background:#3f5236}
.mobile-dialog .mobile-copy-status{min-height:28px;margin:7px 0 0;font-size:10px;color:#546b41}.mobile-open{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:38px;color:#4f6342;text-decoration:none;font-size:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #aebaa17a}.mobile-open:hover{color:#2d4323}.mobile-dialog .mobile-note{margin-top:14px;font-size:10px;color:#8a927f}
.mobile-view .intro,.mobile-view .desktop-tip,.mobile-view .mobile-link{display:none}.mobile-view .workspace{display:block;width:100%;min-height:100svh;height:100dvh;padding:0}.mobile-view .app{width:100%;max-width:520px;height:100dvh;min-height:0;margin:0 auto;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none}
@media(max-width:700px){.mobile-link{top:18px;right:14px;padding:0 10px;font-size:10px;gap:5px}.mobile-dialog{padding:34px 20px 22px}}
app.js
'use strict';
(() => {
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const app = document.querySelector('.app');
  const paper = $('paper'), writer = $('writer'), ink = $('ink');
  const rail = document.querySelector('.rail'), carriage = $('carriage'), head = $('head');
  const STORAGE = 'paper-room-draft-v1', MAX = 3000;
  let editing = false, nativeMode = false, composing = false;
  let shifted = false, symbols = false, lit = true, soundOn = true;
  let railY = 300, lastText = '', lastLine = 0, audio = null;
  let saveTimer, toastTimer, demoTimer, demoRunning = false, returnTimer;
  let animationFrame, storageAvailable = true;
  const reduced = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  const cap = value => [...value].slice(0, MAX).join('');
  try { writer.value = cap(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE) || ''); }
  catch { storageAvailable = false; }
  lastText = writer.value;
  writer.setSelectionRange(writer.value.length, writer.value.length);

  function toast(message) {
    $('toast').textContent = message;
    $('toast').classList.add('visible');
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(() => $('toast').classList.remove('visible'), 2400);
  }

  function save() {
    clearTimeout(saveTimer);
    saveTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE, writer.value);
        storageAvailable = true;
        $('save-indicator').textContent = editing && writer.value ? '已保存' : '';
      } catch {
        storageAvailable = false;
        $('save-indicator').textContent = '请导出留存';
      }
    }, 500);
  }

  function initAudio() {
    if (!soundOn) return;
    try {
      audio ||= new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
      if (audio.state === 'suspended') audio.resume().catch(() => {});
    } catch { audio = null; }
  }

  function clickSound(kind = 'key') {
    if (!soundOn || !audio || audio.state !== 'running') return;
    const now = audio.currentTime;
    if (kind === 'return') {
      const osc = audio.createOscillator(), volume = audio.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sine'; osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1350, now);
      volume.gain.setValueAtTime(.035, now);
      volume.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001, now + .34);
      osc.connect(volume).connect(audio.destination); osc.start(now); osc.stop(now + .35);
    }
    const duration = kind === 'return' ? .18 : .045;
    const buffer = audio.createBuffer(1, Math.ceil(audio.sampleRate * duration), audio.sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * Math.exp(-i / (data.length * .14));
    const source = audio.createBufferSource(), filter = audio.createBiquadFilter(), gain = audio.createGain();
    source.buffer = buffer; filter.type = 'bandpass'; filter.frequency.value = kind === 'space' ? 650 : 1650; filter.Q.value = .7;
    gain.gain.value = kind === 'return' ? .14 : .18;
    source.connect(filter).connect(gain).connect(audio.destination); source.start(now);
    const osc = audio.createOscillator(), tapGain = audio.createGain();
    osc.type = 'triangle'; osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(170, now);
    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(70, now + .035);
    tapGain.gain.setValueAtTime(.035, now); tapGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001, now + .04);
    osc.connect(tapGain).connect(audio.destination); osc.start(now); osc.stop(now + .05);
  }

  function pulse(returning = false, kind = 'key') {
    if (!reduced) {
      head.animate([{ transform:'translateY(0) rotate(0)' }, { transform:'translateY(-2px) rotate(-.6deg)', offset:.22 }, { transform:'translateY(1px) rotate(.3deg)', offset:.65 }, { transform:'translateY(0)' }], { duration:150, easing:'ease-out' });
      document.querySelector('.hammer')?.animate([{ transform:'rotateX(0deg)' }, { transform:'rotateX(68deg) translateY(-3px)', offset:.25 }, { transform:'rotateX(0deg)' }], { duration:130 });
    }
    if (returning) {
      carriage.classList.add('returning');
      clearTimeout(returnTimer);
      returnTimer = setTimeout(() => carriage.classList.remove('returning'), 380);
    }
    clickSound(returning ? 'return' : kind);
  }

  function render(motion = false, kind = 'key') {
    const value = writer.value, cursor = writer.selectionStart ?? value.length;
    const marker = document.createElement('span'); marker.className = 'caret-marker';
    ink.replaceChildren(document.createTextNode(value.slice(0, cursor)), marker, document.createTextNode(value.slice(cursor)));
    app.classList.toggle('has-text', Boolean(value));
    $('counter').querySelector('span').textContent = String([...value].length);
    $('counter').classList.toggle('limit', [...value].length >= MAX);
    $('paper-hint').textContent = value ? '轻点纸张，继续写字' : '轻点纸张，开始写字';
    const caretY = marker.offsetTop;
    const offset = railY - 53 - caretY;
    ink.style.transform = `translateY(${offset}px)`;
    writer.style.transform = `translateY(${offset}px)`;
    writer.style.height = `${Math.max(31, ink.scrollHeight + 4)}px`;
    writer.scrollTop = 0;
    const left = !editing && !value ? paper.clientWidth * .53 : parseFloat(getComputedStyle(ink).left) + marker.offsetLeft;
    const line = Math.round(caretY / parseFloat(getComputedStyle(ink).lineHeight));
    const returning = motion && (line > lastLine || kind === 'return');
    if (motion) pulse(returning, kind);
    const machineX = Math.max(2, Math.min(paper.clientWidth - 76, left - 18));
    carriage.style.left = `${machineX}px`;
    window.paperLamp?.follow(left, railY - 28);
    app.dataset.caretX = left.toFixed(2);
    app.dataset.caretY = String(railY - 28);
    lastLine = line;
  }

  function layout() {
    cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
    animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      railY = Math.max(153, Math.min(paper.clientHeight - 62, paper.clientHeight * (editing ? .66 : .59)));
      rail.style.top = `${railY}px`;
      // The paper continues below the rail when the caret moves to an earlier line.
      // Leave room for the footer; the rail's own image supplies its occlusion.
      const writingBottom = Math.max(railY + 32, paper.clientHeight - 56);
      document.querySelector('.ink-window').style.height = `${writingBottom}px`;
      document.querySelector('.placeholder').style.top = `${railY - 101}px`;
      render();
    });
  }
  new ResizeObserver(layout).observe(paper);

  function begin({ native = false } = {}) {
    editing = true; nativeMode = native;
    app.classList.add('editing'); app.classList.toggle('native-mode', nativeMode);
    $('keyboard').inert = nativeMode;
    writer.setAttribute('inputmode', native ? 'text' : 'none');
    writer.focus({ preventScroll:true }); initAudio(); layout(); render();
  }

  function done() {
    stopDemo(); editing = false; nativeMode = false;
    app.classList.remove('editing', 'native-mode');
    $('keyboard').inert = true;
    writer.blur(); $('save-indicator').textContent = ''; save(); layout();
  }

  function stopDemo() { clearTimeout(demoTimer); demoRunning = false; $('demo').disabled = false; }

  function commit(value, cursor, kind = 'key') {
    if ([...value].length > MAX) { toast('这一页已经写满了，可以导出留存'); return; }
    writer.value = value;
    writer.setSelectionRange(cursor, cursor);
    lastText = value;
    $('save-indicator').textContent = '';
    render(true, kind); save();
  }

  function insert(text) {
    const start = writer.selectionStart ?? writer.value.length, end = writer.selectionEnd ?? start;
    commit(writer.value.slice(0, start) + text + writer.value.slice(end), start + text.length, text === '\n' ? 'return' : text === ' ' ? 'space' : 'key');
  }

  function erase() {
    const start = writer.selectionStart, end = writer.selectionEnd;
    if (!start && start === end) return;
    let from = start;
    if (start === end) {
      if ('Segmenter' in Intl) {
        const parts = [...new Intl.Segmenter(undefined, { granularity:'grapheme' }).segment(writer.value.slice(0, start))];
        from = parts.at(-1)?.index ?? 0;
      } else from = start - (writer.value.codePointAt(start - 2) > 0xFFFF ? 2 : 1);
    }
    commit(writer.value.slice(0, from) + writer.value.slice(end), from, 'delete');
  }

  function flash(key) {
    const keyButton = [...document.querySelectorAll('.key')].find(b => b.dataset.key.toLowerCase() === key.toLowerCase());
    if (!keyButton) return;
    keyButton.classList.add('active');
    clearTimeout(keyButton._timer);
    keyButton._timer = setTimeout(() => keyButton.classList.remove('active'), 130);
  }

  function drawKeyboard() {
    const rows = symbols ? ['1234567890', '-/:;()$&@"', '.,?!\''] : ['qwertyuiop', 'asdfghjkl', 'zxcvbnm'];
    const keyboard = $('keys'); keyboard.replaceChildren();
    function key(parent, value, label, cls = '', icon = '') {
      const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.className = `key ${cls}`; b.dataset.key = value;
      b.setAttribute('aria-label', label);
      if (icon) b.innerHTML = `<svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-${icon}"/></svg>`;
      else b.append(document.createTextNode(label));
      if (value.length === 1 && value !== ' ') {
        const pop = document.createElement('span'); pop.className = 'key-pop'; pop.textContent = label; b.append(pop);
      }
      parent.append(b);
      b.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => { event.preventDefault(); });
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        stopDemo(); initAudio();
        if (!editing) begin();
        if (value === 'Shift') { shifted = !shifted; drawKeyboard(); return; }
        if (value === 'Symbols') { symbols = !symbols; drawKeyboard(); return; }
        if (value === 'Backspace') erase();
        else if (value === 'Enter') insert('\n');
        else insert(value);
        flash(value);
        if (shifted && /^[A-Z]$/.test(value)) { shifted = false; setTimeout(drawKeyboard, 140); }
      });
    }
    rows.forEach((letters, index) => {
      const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'key-row'; keyboard.append(row);
      if (index === 2) key(row, 'Shift', '切换大小写', `special ${shifted ? 'shift-on' : ''}`, 'shift');
      for (const letter of letters) {
        const character = shifted ? letter.toUpperCase() : letter;
        key(row, character, character);
      }
      if (index === 2) key(row, 'Backspace', '退格', 'special', 'delete');
    });
    const row = document.createElement('div'); row.className = 'key-row'; keyboard.append(row);
    key(row, 'Symbols', symbols ? 'ABC' : '123', 'special');
    key(row, ',', ',', 'special');
    key(row, ' ', 'space', 'space');
    row.querySelector('[data-key=" "]').firstChild.textContent = '';
    key(row, 'Enter', '换行', 'special return', 'return');
  }

  writer.addEventListener('focus', () => {
    if (!editing) { editing = true; app.classList.add('editing'); $('keyboard').inert = false; initAudio(); render(); }
  });
  writer.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') { event.preventDefault(); done(); return; }
    if (event.isComposing || composing || event.key === 'Process') return;
    stopDemo(); initAudio(); flash(event.key);
  });
  writer.addEventListener('compositionstart', () => { stopDemo(); composing = true; });
  writer.addEventListener('compositionend', () => {
    composing = false; writer.value = cap(writer.value); lastText = writer.value; render(true); save();
  });
  writer.addEventListener('input', event => {
    if (composing || event.isComposing) { render(); return; }
    if ([...writer.value].length > MAX) {
      writer.value = cap(writer.value);
      toast('这一页已经写满了，可以导出留存');
    }
    const changed = writer.value !== lastText;
    const kind = event.inputType === 'insertLineBreak' ? 'return' : event.data === ' ' ? 'space' : 'key';
    lastText = writer.value;
    $('save-indicator').textContent = '';
    render(changed, kind); save();
  });
  writer.addEventListener('select', () => { if (!composing) render(); });
  writer.addEventListener('pointerup', () => requestAnimationFrame(() => render()));
  document.addEventListener('selectionchange', () => { if(document.activeElement === writer && !composing) render(); });
  writer.addEventListener('keyup', event => { if (event.key.startsWith('Arrow') || ['Home','End'].includes(event.key)) render(); });
  paper.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (event.target.closest('button, a')) return;
    stopDemo(); begin({ native:nativeMode });
  });
  $('done').addEventListener('click', done);
  $('native').addEventListener('pointerdown', event => event.preventDefault());
  $('native').addEventListener('click', () => {
    writer.blur(); begin({ native:true });
    if (!matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches) toast('可以直接使用电脑的中文输入法');
  });

  function toggleLight() {
    lit = !lit; app.classList.toggle('light-off', !lit); window.paperLamp?.setLit(lit);
    for (const id of ['lamp', 'light']) { $(id).setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(lit)); $(id).setAttribute('aria-label', lit ? '关闭台灯' : '打开台灯'); }
    initAudio(); clickSound('space');
  }
  $('lamp').addEventListener('click', toggleLight);
  $('light').addEventListener('click', toggleLight);
  for (const id of ['lamp', 'light']) $(id).addEventListener('pointerdown', event => event.preventDefault());
  $('sound').addEventListener('pointerdown', event => event.preventDefault());
  $('sound').addEventListener('click', () => {
    soundOn = !soundOn; $('sound').setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(soundOn));
    $('sound').setAttribute('aria-label', soundOn ? '关闭打字音效' : '打开打字音效');
    initAudio(); if (soundOn) clickSound();
  });
  $('new-page').addEventListener('click', () => {
    stopDemo();
    if (writer.value) { writer.blur(); $('new-dialog').showModal(); }
    else begin();
  });
  $('new-dialog').addEventListener('close', () => {
    if ($('new-dialog').returnValue === 'new') {
      writer.value = ''; lastText = ''; lastLine = 0; render(); save();
      paper.classList.remove('new-sheet'); void paper.offsetWidth; paper.classList.add('new-sheet');
    }
    if (editing) begin({ native:nativeMode });
  });
  $('export').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!writer.value.trim()) { toast('写下几句话，再把这一页带走'); return; }
    stopDemo();
    const blob = new Blob([writer.value], { type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob), link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url; link.download = `纸间-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.txt`;
    document.body.append(link); link.click(); link.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 2000); toast('这一页，已经为你留下');
  });
  $('demo').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (writer.value) { begin(); toast('这张纸已经有你的文字，换张新纸后可看示范'); return; }
    begin(); demoRunning = true; $('demo').disabled = true;
    const message = 'A little room\nfor your thoughts.\n\n慢一点，也没关系。';
    const characters = [...message]; let index = 0;
    function tick() {
      if (!demoRunning) return;
      if (index >= characters.length) { stopDemo(); return; }
      const character = characters[index++]; insert(character); flash(character);
      demoTimer = setTimeout(tick, character === '\n' ? 480 : 105 + Math.random() * 80);
    }
    demoTimer = setTimeout(tick, 400);
  });

  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => { try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE, writer.value); } catch {} });
  if (window.visualViewport) {
    function adjustViewport() {
      if (window.innerWidth <= 520 || document.documentElement.classList.contains('mobile-view')) app.style.height = `${window.visualViewport.height}px`;
      else app.style.removeProperty('height');
    }
    window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', adjustViewport); adjustViewport();
  }
  drawKeyboard(); layout();
  window.addEventListener('paper-lamp-ready', layout);
  if (!storageAvailable) $('save-indicator').textContent = '请导出留存';
})();
lamp.js
'use strict';
(() => {
  const paper=document.getElementById('paper'),lamp=document.getElementById('lamp');
  const canvas=document.getElementById('lamp-head'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
  const beam=document.getElementById('light-beam'),light=beam.getContext('2d');
  const reduced=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  let manifest,frames=[],angle=0,target=0,lit=true,raf=0,lastTime=0,caret={x:60,y:300};
  const clamp=(x,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));
  function schedule(){if(!raf)raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);}
  function tick(time){
    raf=0;const dt=lastTime?Math.min(50,time-lastTime):16;lastTime=time;
    angle=reduced?target:angle+(target-angle)*(1-Math.exp(-dt/140));
    if(Math.abs(angle-target)<.025)angle=target;
    draw();if(angle!==target)schedule();else lastTime=0;
  }
  function draw(){
    if(!frames.length)return;
    const candidates=frames.filter(f=>f.lit===lit);
    const frame=candidates.reduce((best,f)=>Math.abs(f.degrees-angle)<Math.abs(best.degrees-angle)?f:best,candidates[0]);
    const pivot=manifest.lampPivot,delta=-(angle-frame.degrees)*Math.PI/180*.94;
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,900,900);ctx.save();ctx.translate(pivot.x,pivot.y);ctx.rotate(delta);
    ctx.drawImage(frame.image,-pivot.x,-pivot.y,900,900);ctx.restore();
    const w=paper.clientWidth,h=paper.clientHeight,dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);
    if(beam.width!==Math.round(w*dpr)||beam.height!==Math.round(h*dpr)){beam.width=Math.round(w*dpr);beam.height=Math.round(h*dpr);}
    light.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);light.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
    const dx=frame.mouth.x-pivot.x,dy=frame.mouth.y-pivot.y;
    const mouth={x:pivot.x+dx*Math.cos(delta)-dy*Math.sin(delta),y:pivot.y+dx*Math.sin(delta)+dy*Math.cos(delta)};
    const ratio=lamp.clientWidth/900;
    const sx=lamp.offsetLeft+mouth.x*ratio,sy=lamp.offsetTop+mouth.y*ratio;
    // A tapered soft cone starts at the actual rendered shade opening.
    const length=clamp(caret.y-sy+110,130,390);
    const direction=(angle+11)*Math.PI/180;
    const ex=sx+Math.sin(direction)*length,ey=sy+Math.cos(direction)*length;
    if(lit){
      for(let i=0;i>=0;i--){
        const spread=1+i*.11;
        const near=lamp.clientWidth*.145,far=length*.31*spread;
        const g=light.createLinearGradient(sx,sy,ex,ey);
        g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,246,203,${.48})`);
        g.addColorStop(.15,`rgba(255,238,169,${.28})`);
        g.addColorStop(.62,`rgba(255,237,178,${.12})`);
        g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,240,195,0)');
        light.fillStyle=g;light.filter=`blur(14px)`;
        light.beginPath();light.moveTo(sx-near,sy-3);
        light.quadraticCurveTo(sx-near*.9+(ex-sx)*.3,sy+length*.38,ex-far,ey);
        light.quadraticCurveTo(ex,ey+length*.12,ex+far,ey);
        light.quadraticCurveTo(sx+near*.9+(ex-sx)*.3,sy+length*.38,sx+near,sy-3);
        light.closePath();light.fill();
      }
      light.filter='none';
    }
    lamp.dataset.angle=angle.toFixed(2);lamp.dataset.mouthX=sx.toFixed(2);lamp.dataset.mouthY=sy.toFixed(2);
  }
  window.paperLamp={
    follow(x,y){caret={x,y};const editing=document.querySelector('.app').classList.contains('editing');target=editing?clamp((x/paper.clientWidth-.38)*35,-14,18):0;schedule();},
    setLit(value){lit=Boolean(value);schedule();},
    state(){return {angle,target,lit,loaded:frames.length,pivot:manifest?.lampPivot,caret};}
  };
  new ResizeObserver(schedule).observe(paper);
  fetch('assets/manifest.json').then(r=>{if(!r.ok)throw Error('Material manifest failed');return r.json();}).then(async data=>{
    manifest=data;
    frames=await Promise.all(data.angles.map(async f=>{const image=new Image();image.src='assets/'+f.file.replace('.png','.webp');await image.decode();return {...f,image};}));
    lamp.classList.add('assets-ready');schedule();window.dispatchEvent(new Event('paper-lamp-ready'));
  }).catch(error=>{console.error(error);lamp.dataset.assetError='true';});
})();
